about: The second look (scripts/gen/trials/checks.ts --second): does it overturn a wrong key and uphold a right one? Wrong keys are the answer letters DOE misprinted, shown as printed, each with the answer a solver gave; disputed keys are the two the November 2026 pilot questioned; "right key, wrong solver" is a DOE question with a made-up solver who chose another choice; spot checks have no finding at all.

results.reason: The US 1996 Battery Act banned mercuric-oxide button cells outright and restricted all other mercuric-oxide batteries, making them nearly obsolete; NiCd cells only became subject to labeling and recycling rules and are still sold.
'Aeolian' means wind-driven, so aeolian sandstones form from sand that wind transported and deposited. River currents produce fluvial deposits, not aeolian ones.
Glacial meltwater streams with high bed load and easily eroded banks form braided channel patterns; an oxbow is a cut-off meander lake, not a stream pattern.

The USGS compares lava-dome growth at Mount St. Helens to squeezing a tube of toothpaste, and several dacite domes have formed in the crater since 1980 (1980 domes, 1980–86, 2004–08). No cinder cone has formed there.
Basaltic (mafic) lava contains about 45–52% silica, so about 50%; 60% is the usual figure for andesitic lava.
A difference of one magnitude means a brightness ratio of 100^(1/5), about 2.512, which rounds to 2.5. The keyed 3.2 is the square root of 10, which matches a difference of 1.25 magnitudes.
NASA sources say Mars's seasonal polar caps are mainly carbon dioxide frost (dry ice), not carbon monoxide. Water ice makes up the permanent caps, which the word 'seasonal' rules out.
Nearly all supernovae are discovered by ground-based optical surveys (ZTF, ATLAS, ASAS-SN, Pan-STARRS) and amateurs, not in the ultraviolet; the solver's answer of visible/optical is correct.
Macrophages come from monocytes and are standardly classified as white blood cells (leukocytes), so the key wrongly leaves them out; only the melanocyte is not a leukocyte.

Iodine deficiency is the classic cause of goiter. Sodium, chlorine and potassium are major minerals, not trace elements, and their deficiency does not cause goiter; the solver likely confused iodine with the salt used to carry it.
With ΔH < 0 and ΔS > 0, ΔG = ΔH − TΔS is negative at every temperature. The solver's answer Y applies when ΔH < 0 and ΔS < 0, not here.

Foliation comes from minerals lining up under directed (differential) stress. Temperature controls metamorphic grade, not whether foliation forms; high-temperature contact metamorphism without directed stress gives non-foliated hornfels.

Voltage drops by IR along a line with constant current, so Z is right. But X) Energy is also defensible, because electrical energy is lost as I²R heat over long distances, and that loss is the same effect as the voltage drop.

fix.stem: In electricity transmission, at consistent current and resistance per unit length, which of the following, measured at a point on the line, changes with distance from the generator? W) Resistance per unit length X) Current Y) Charge Z) Voltage

results.reason: Side = 2R sin(180°/n) = 16 sin 5° ≈ 1.395; W (≈7.88) is nearly the radius and impossible for a 36-gon side, and X (≈1.389) differs by a factor of cos 5°.

Huntington's disease is autosomal dominant, while sickle-cell disease and Tay-Sachs are autosomal recessive and hemophilia A is X-linked recessive. The solver's choice X probably confuses codominance of the sickle allele at the protein level with dominant inheritance of the disease.

results.reason: Diagenesis is the set of physical and chemical changes, including compaction and mild burial heating, that sediment goes through after deposition. Nitrogen fixation (X) is a nitrogen-cycle process unrelated to diagenesis, so the solver was wrong.
Sphalerite (ZnS) is the main ore of zinc. Chalcocite and malachite are copper ores, and dolomite, CaMg(CO3)2, has no zinc; it only hosts some zinc deposits, so the solver's choice of Z is wrong.

Bragg coherent diffraction imaging at Argonne's Advanced Photon Source uses coherent hard X-rays (about 9 keV, about 0.14 nm), since Bragg diffraction needs wavelengths close to the spacing between atoms. Ultraviolet wavelengths are far too long, so the solver's choice X is wrong.
Phenotype is the standard term for the composite of an organism's observable characteristics and traits; no other term fits this definition.
Biotite, like all micas, has a single perfect basal cleavage on {001}, so it has one cleavage plane/direction.
The slope of a velocity-versus-time graph is dv/dt, which by definition is acceleration (constant, since the function is linear). No other quantity a knowledgeable player might name fits.
Parietal cells secrete hydrochloric acid, which gives the stomach its low pH. Asking for a 'specific acid' rules out the general term 'gastric acid,' so only one answer is correct.

Ocean acidification is the correct reason deep-ocean CO2 storage was abandoned, but the bare answer line could lead a judge to reject equivalent answers like 'decrease in pH' or 'formation of carbonic acid.'
